claim.statement: API tokens carry one of three roles (admin, deployer, read-only), can be scoped to apps and namespaces, live 90 days by default (admin no expiry), rotate with a 24 hour grace for the old secret, and the last admin token cannot be revoked.

sources.quote: Deployer and read-only tokens live **90 days** unless you say otherwise
`revoke` refuses to remove the last admin token
relish token rotate ci-deploy                  # old secret works for 24 hours

claim.measurable: Create tokens per role and verify allowed and denied routes (read-only cannot apply; deployer cannot manage tokens, rotate secrets, sign images or decommission; only unscoped admin can). A namespace-scoped token cannot see or touch another namespace (403 and an api.refused audit record). Old secret works for 24 h after rotate (--grace-hours 0 stops it now) then returns 401 token rotated; the new one propagates to other nodes within 5 s.
